acceptance.volume_metric: reported; geometry acceptance requires Boolean confirmation for differences > 1e-6 mm3
acceptance.analytic_bbox_discrepancy: Require Boolean confirmation and sampled bounds within 1e-6 mm at 0.01 and 0.005 mm deflection

method: One-to-one source/STEP solid matching by six bounding coordinates; absolute volume errors summed without cancellation; Boolean difference confirmation for discrepant solids. Compound-level volume estimate retained for transparency.
